title: Bitcoin self-custody solutions see record downloads amid ban
content:
TL;DR: Amid escalating concerns over traditional banking stability, Bitcoin self-custody solutions are witnessing a significant surge in downloads, signaling a global pivot towards individual monetary sovereignty. This movement underscores Bitcoin's fundamental value proposition as a censorship-resistant asset, empowering transactors to reclaim control of their wealth outside fragile financial institutions. The network's robust operational status, with a hashrate of 870.98 EH/s, continues to provide an unshakeable foundation for this critical shift.

The Report

February 03, 2026 – In a telling response to persistent anxieties within the conventional banking sector, a noticeable and rapid uptick in downloads and adoption of Bitcoin self-custody solutions has been observed across various platforms. From open-source software wallets to dedicated hardware devices, the trend indicates a decisive move by individuals and entities to withdraw their digital assets from centralized exchanges and traditional financial custodians, embracing the principle of "being your own bank."
